data.name: Rehbar
data.gender_notes: Rehbar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rehbar is a name that signifies a leader or a guide, often used to denote someone who leads others on the right path. The name Rehbar carries the meaning “Leader or Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rehbar usually hope their child will grow to embody leader or guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, a Rehbar is considered someone who guides others towards righteousness and virtue, much like the Prophets who are considered guides for the believers.
data.etymology: Rehbar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader or Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehbar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
